description: Defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for managing a directory cache in a version control system, including cache entries, index state, and cache manipulation functions.

methods.name: copy_cache_entry
methods.description: Copies sha1 and stat data from one cache entry to another without altering name or hash state.

methods.name: create_ce_flags
methods.description: Creates cache entry flags based on stage.

methods.name: index_state_init
methods.description: Initializes an index_state structure with a repository.

methods.name: release_index
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an index_state.

methods.name: make_cache_entry
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry for the index.

methods.name: validate_cache_entries
methods.description: Validates cache entries in the index for internal consistency.

methods.name: add_index_entry
methods.description: Adds a cache entry to the index with specified options.

methods.name: refresh_index
methods.description: Refreshes the index entries based on filesystem state.

methods.name: repo_index_has_changes
methods.description: Checks if the index differs from the tree or HEAD.
